title: Largest Plus Sign
goal: Find the largest axis-aligned plus made of ones in a grid with mined zero cells.
strategy: A plus order is limited by its shortest arm including the center. Four directional sweeps compute consecutive-one runs and retain the minimum of left right up and down at every cell.
